items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Dud Bascomb, Doug Baskin, yeah. His father's name was Doug Baskin also. What band was he in? [INTERVIEWEE] It was Erskine Hawkins' band. He's the guy that played that trumpet solo on "Tuxedo Junction" that everybody has to copy.

ctx.x: he is in California now. I can't remember. And then this young kid, Dud Bascomb? (Wilbur Bascomb -- ed.)

It was Erskine Hawkins' band. He's the guy that played that trumpet solo on "Tuxedo Junction" that everybody has to copy.
